Fantastic draw.

Corriere dello Sport
Lazio sky
Seven wins in eight games. Game unlocked in the second half by Taylor. Diego Carlos’ own goal. Lontani closes the gap in the 95th minute. On Tuesday, the game against Sassuolo. Esposito and Thuram at 12:30 for the assault on Sassuolo.
Romuntada
Infinite Roma: Spectacle at the Maradona, Gasperini’s substitutions are decisive
What a show: 3-3 against Napoli
Anguissa’s bicycle kick and McTominay’s goal. Gian Piero climbs back with Soulé and Balerdi. Scott puts his name on the overtaking and, in the 89th minute, the ex-Marseille defender equalises again. Allegri sent off: ‘They send me off as I move.’
Douvikas leads Como: 2-0 against Sassuolo
Juve, Lucio’s in a hurry
Just five points in five games. Woltemde and Kolo Munai confirmed up front. DiFra: ‘The feat is possible.’
Tuttosport
Kolo, are you here?
Spalletti asks for more for the breakthrough, especially from the Frenchman.
He has the trust of the club, coach, and teammates; he has found in Woltemade a teammate who opens spaces. All the conditions are there for him to make an impact. Doubt between Alajbegovic and…Gatti! It depends on the playing style.
Bruno: ‘Toro, I like it this way.’
‘Well done, boys, make the enthusiasm explode.’
Balerdi does a Malen; Roma’s 3-3 comeback sparks Allegri’s anger.
